北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感舒适。别忘了补充水分哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and feels comfortable. Don't forget to hydrate!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波小雨体感热。湿度高，出门带伞，注意安全！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has light rain and feels hot. High humidity, bring an umbrella and stay safe!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天体感热。注意防暑，保持心情舒畅！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast and feels hot. Protect yourself from the heat and stay cheerful!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 34℃，高温炎热。多饮水，注意防暑降温！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels like 34℃, hot and sweltering. Drink more water and take measures to cool down!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天体感闷热。注意防暑降温，保持通风！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast and feels stuffy and hot. Stay cool and ensure good ventilation!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾湿度大。出行小心慢行，注意交通安全！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy with high humidity. Drive carefully and be mindful of road safety!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云体感热。湿度高，注意除湿，保持清爽！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and feels hot. High humidity, so dehumidify and stay fresh!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都体感 34℃ 高温。及时补水，避免长时间户外！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu feels like 34℃ with high temperatures. Hydrate promptly and avoid long outdoor exposure!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云体感热。多饮水，防中暑，注意休息！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels hot. Drink plenty of water, prevent heatstroke, and rest well!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 33℃。防晒补水，注意防暑哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels like 33℃. Wear sunscreen, hydrate, and prevent heatstroke!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴朗高温。体感 34℃，防晒补水是关键！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny with high temperatures. Feels like 34℃, sun protection and hydration are key!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感舒适。享受美好天气，保持好心情！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and feels comfortable. Enjoy the beautiful weather and stay happy!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳中雨，出门带伞。气温舒适，雨天也快乐！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has moderate rain, bring an umbrella. Comfortable temperature, enjoy the rainy day!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感凉爽。风力大，注意添衣别着凉！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels cool. Windy, so dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天湿度大。注意除湿，保持衣物干爽哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast with high humidity. Dehumidify and keep your clothes dry!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感适宜。户外活动，也要注意防晒哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels pleasant. For outdoor activities, remember your sun protection!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阵雨，湿度较高。出门记得带伞，保持好心情！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has showers and high humidity. Remember your umbrella and stay cheerful!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天体感热。湿度大，及时补水，注意防暑！
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is overcast and feels hot. High humidity, hydrate promptly and prevent heatstroke!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨，湿度高。出门记得带伞，小心路滑！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain and high humidity. Remember your umbrella and watch out for slippery roads!
